text: Do you like to keep things tidy?

speaker: B
name: Mia
text: I would say I'm kind of lazy, so my things get messy sometimes. But here's the thing — I do like tidy things, it's just that... if things can become messy automatically, then keeping them tidy is a losing battle. So I'd say I like tidiness in theory, but laziness wins.
